response.overview: "There would have been no Billy Graham as we know him today had it not been for Ruth" - T.W. Wilson  Discover fresh insights into the adventurous personality and contagious faith of Ruth Bell Graham! Beginning with a childhood spent in China, God led her through a life that few could imagine. She inspired millions with her writing and raised five children---all while managing the considerable demands of being the wife of the most well-known evangelist in the world.  Find out why her husband called her "the greatest Christian I've ever known."  Features world-premier music performances from Avalon and Fernando Ortega, plus a special performance from Bill and Gloria Gaither.
response.title: Celebrating Ruth Bell Graham
